roles.vocabulary: agent-input-port.v1 canonical roles plus x- extension namespace
roles.inference_policy: never infer role from numerical layer type
roles.transition_policy: input and output roles are explicitly declared by SemanticTransitionSpec

lineage.external_slot_0: slot 0 is external only when no prior step has written slot 0; that origin must resolve through an exact persistent input edge binding whose provenance still matches current external metadata
lineage.internal_slot: any consumed slot, including slot 0 after overwrite, resolves to the latest prior topology step that writes the slot and that producer must already have a semantic lifecycle transition
lineage.slot_reuse: latest prior producer before the consumer step is authoritative

binding.immutability: first successful binding wins; identical rebinding is idempotent and conflicting rebinding fails closed
binding.clear_surface: none; changing semantic meaning requires a new graph builder or graph revision

identity.explicit_non_identity: CompiledGraph.programIdentity remains executable-machine identity and is not changed by lifecycle transitions

inspection.graph_introspection: describeGraph exposes semantic_lifecycle_transition per step and semantic_lifecycle_identity at graph level

bindSemanticLifecycleTransition.returns: true for first binding, false for identical idempotent binding

invariants: semantic lifecycle transition never changes executable plan bytes
semantic lifecycle transition never mutates AgentWorkspace or LayerRegistry
semantic lifecycle transition never authorizes execution or selects an action
semantic lifecycle transition never infers role from layer type
external lineage is anchored to persistent edge binding provenance
slot index 0 is not sufficient to classify lineage as external after a prior write
internal lineage is anchored to a prior transition fingerprint
conflicting transition rebinding fails without rewriting history
partial lifecycle coverage is reported explicitly rather than auto-filled
